content: Ama nukare nena mou-mau nimorekare wara nikare itazaita wero tuma diai nisokare besai azu, na ge ei awa bere-bere kerenitinona awa.
Nukare yere ibu soyamunora. Awa daba kota, be zo mamunoya be amire nukare ‘Anutura bua inowenakare’ asinoise nikare dara bebetenamunowa.
Nukare nato Mamere awa kaka giro baitamu inowera, are ago ine wamunora.

Ge tona ami me wai amire, ‘Yesu gita namorekai ago senua,’ ago sawise sero nikare bere-bere tugata inona. Ozanara bua amira ge. Na nikare gipamu sero bua zaawero noina be amire be naso iboi itinua, are na ge awa gita nimorekare kaka samu noisona.
Ata zeme meni awa na senu osena amira nana witamu sero inona, are ge awa sesena. Ata nisokare nana zo meni na ego kaka atata wamu inoya, ‘Ni nago bayamunosi?’
Ge ago ine nimorekare sesena, are duba nai meni moka nisokare bera muro itia.

Na ge me sana niniu. Na ewesemuro witamunona, awa nikare kokopai itawise sero witamunona. Na kaka witamu wamunona, awa Soremai meni oko osamunoya. Ata na witiro iyetana osero nimorekare dai nuamunoya.
Osero nena etorobara amira susu awa eramare kerenamunoya: pasinara susu, ata ewanana wero nuaira susu, ata pasinara ina tamai amira susu. Nu susu etorobara awa kerenai eraa meni gara me wamunoya.
Pasinara susu ego ine gipai gamunora: nukare na kaka tuma diamu inowera, are pasina nusokare dago itewia.
Ewanana wero nuaira susu ego ine gipai gamunora: na Mamera nana ewesemuro witana nikare na noko oko gamunowa.
Pasinara ina tamai amira susu ego ine gipai gamunora: zebu emira tua awa Anutura kotora ena duwaise sai itia.
Ge tugata wai naso dainiro dago itia, ata nikare zeme ninai ine tepo.

Ge me susure sai awa Ozana awa. Nune osero ge me dapikarago susure nimorekare gipamunoya. Ota ge awa kotumai nusora oko puro samunoya. Ge naneto Mamere samunonato awa niniro te nikare tugata wamunoya. Tani eure-taure ama kei awamunora awa dai bere-bere nimorekare kerenamunoya.
Na ge sana Ozana meni niniro puro nimorekare kerenamunoya. Ago wai bowi naso kei awamunoya awa.
Mamera nena dapikarago awa nena naso, ami emo na nimorekare ego sesena awa, ‘Ozana meni nena naso puro nimorekare kerenamunoya.’
Yesu nu baro noko ewesemuro mamunoya.
Be apunu-kaka itia awa tepo wai amire nikare na oko gamunowa. Noko be apunu-kaka tepo wai amire nikare na gamunowa.”

Yesu meni ago senu bua mai nuso nutopekare ge ina-sa wero ego sewa awa, “Nu ego toya, ‘Be apunu-kaka itia awa tepo wai amire nikare na oko gamunowa. Noko be apunu-kaka tepo wai amire nikare na gamunowa.’ Nu nogoro ago toi? Ota nu ge zo dai ego sesia awa, ‘Na Mamera nana witamunona.’ Ago sesia awa.”
Bua mai meni ago sero noko ego sewa awa, “Nu ego sesia, ‘Be apunu-kaka itia.’ Ago awa nogoro toi, nakai sirinonakai.”

Ago sero nu atata wamu sero wewa Yesu nu nutope giro ego senua awa, “Ge ego nimorekare sesena amira ina-sa inowita? ‘Be apunu-kaka itia awa tepo wai amire nikare na oko gamunowa. Noko be apunu-kaka tepo wai amire nikare na gamunowa.’ Ge amira susu sana gamu towita?

Na me memeka nimorekare tona. Nikare dire-buare inuawa ema na tuma kaka diamu ami yawa sara wamunora. Nikare duba naire nuawa duba nai nisokare meni kapetenai yawa sara wai nisokare nana kei awamunoya.
Bama meni mai pamu inoma yaya tapinoise duba nitinowera. Ago inoma mai puro oreniro ‘mai pumena’ asero yawa sara inowera. Yaya tapinowera awa oko kotupitinowera.
Da ago ine nikare zeme duba nitinowa. Ata na nikare noko gamunona be amire nikare yawa sara bamubake wamunowa. Yawa sara nisokare awa ema zo meni kapai tepo wai ine tepo.
Are be amire nikare nena zo kau wero giro na oko atata wamunowa. Na me memeka sane. Nikare nena zo emo Mama begomo sawa nena awa potamunoya. Awa nera kota, nu na emo inoise potamunoya.
Noisonakai amira ana tupise nikare zazo naso puro noise nena zo emo begomo kaka samu. Are yawa sara wai meni nisokare nana kei awero be muro itaise begomo seu. Begomo sawa potai pamunowa awa.
Yesura zazo puro noise Anutu begomo sai.

Ge nimorekare tugata wero tupewena awa ge bezai tugata inowena. Noma be zo mamunoya amire na ge bezai meni awa oko samunona. Be amire na Mamera susu poti damu namu ge bezero kota, me kereniro nimorekare samunona.
Be amire nikare zazo naso puro noise Mama begomo samunowa. Na ego oko tona, ‘Nane nikare soremuro Mama begomo samunona.’ Awa oko tona. Awa nera kota, Mama meni nikare ara tapinowia.
Na Mamera nana ena osena ge awa nikare niniwa me wenu na ara tapinowewa. Are Mama meni da ago ine nikare ara tapinowia.
Na Mama doro zebura osena, are na zebu doro noko Mamera nana wititinona.”
Ago senu bua mai nuso meni ego sewa awa, “Ni zeme ge bezai doro damu-damuke kereniro tosa awa.
Are nimore ego gosinonakare: ni nitope nena dapikarago giro tepo inowesa. Nakare ni atata wamu kotupitinuawenakare ni nitope gosinowesa, ami emo ni Anutura nana ena osesa awa genakare me inoya.”
Ago sewa Yesu meni ego senua awa, “Nikare zeme gewa me inoita?

Be zo itia awa eya mai amire na doro bozero nata nisokare sero baro tepo wamunowa. Ago wero na duawa na imata nuamunona. Ata na imata oko nuamunona. Mama meni namore dai nowia, are imata oko nuamunona.

Nikare azu doro oreniro nuawise sero ge ei awa nimorekare sesena. Nikare zebura yayare duba naire nuamunowa. Ata nane zebura nena dire-bere awa puro osero patitinona, are nikare putoure noiwo.” Ago senua awa.
